title: Earth Vital Signs - Daily Climate Indicators
subtitle: Sea ice, CO2, greenhouse gases and ocean temperature, updated daily
description:
Four headline climate indicators in tidy CSV, rebuilt every day by GitHub Actions from the original NOAA and NSIDC files.

The popular Kaggle copies of these series stopped updating in 2017-2019. This one is regenerated daily, and a version is only published after automated checks pass: dates unique and complete, values in a plausible range, the latest date recent, and every previously published row older than the revision window unchanged. Sea surface temperature means are computed here from the full 0.25-degree NOAA OISST v2.1 grid (cos-latitude weighted) and cross-checked each run against a second, independent copy of the same day from NCEI.

Source code and the full history of every update: https://github.com/yasumorishima/earth-vital-signs

## Files

- `sea_ice_extent_daily.csv` - Arctic and Antarctic sea ice extent, 1978-10-26 to present (every other day until 1987-08)
- `co2_daily_mauna_loa.csv` - daily mean CO2 at Mauna Loa, 1974 to present
- `greenhouse_gases_monthly.csv` - monthly CO2 (Mauna Loa and global), CH4, N2O and SF6 (global marine surface)
- `sst_daily.csv` - daily mean sea surface temperature for 60S-60N and the North Atlantic (0-60N, 0-80W), 1981-09-01 to present, with anomalies against 1991-2020

## Sources and citation

The data are produced by the organizations below, which ask to be cited. Please cite them, not this dataset, in any publication.

- Sea ice: Fetterer, F., Knowles, K., Meier, W. N., Savoie, M., Windnagel, A. K. & Stafford, T. (2025). Sea Ice Index (G02135, Version 4). Boulder, Colorado USA. NSIDC: National Snow and Ice Data Center. https://doi.org/10.7265/a98x-0f50
- Mauna Loa CO2: Dr. Xin Lan, NOAA/GML (gml.noaa.gov/ccgg/trends/) and Dr. Ralph Keeling, Scripps Institution of Oceanography (scrippsco2.ucsd.edu/). Monthly values before 1974-05 are Scripps measurements.
- Global greenhouse gases: Lan, X., Tans, P. and K.W. Thoning: Trends in globally-averaged CO2 determined from NOAA Global Monitoring Laboratory measurements. https://doi.org/10.15138/9N0H-ZH07 (and the corresponding CH4, N2O and SF6 pages at https://gml.noaa.gov/ccgg/trends/)
- Sea surface temperature: NOAA OISST v2.1 (Huang, B. et al. 2021, J. Climate, doi:10.1175/JCLI-D-20-0166.1). Data provided by the NOAA PSL, Boulder, Colorado, USA, from their website at https://psl.noaa.gov

## License

The values are redistributed under the terms of each source, which make them freely available and require attribution as above. The derived SST means and the build code are MIT-licensed (see the GitHub repository).

## Notes

- Recent values can be revised by the source (preliminary SST for about two weeks, CO2 after calibration). Rows older than the revision window are frozen; the checks stop the update if a source rewrites them.
- Monthly global gas averages lag by a few months, as published by NOAA GML.
- This dataset is not affiliated with NOAA or NSIDC.

resources.description: Daily sea ice extent for each hemisphere from the NSIDC Sea Ice Index v4.

fields.name: extent_mkm2
fields.description: Sea ice extent in million square kilometres (area with at least 15% ice concentration)

fields.name: missing_mkm2
fields.description: Area with missing satellite data, million square kilometres (0 on almost all days)

fields.name: extent_5day_mean_mkm2
fields.description: Trailing 5-day mean of extent as used in NSIDC charts; empty where the 5 previous days are not all present (every-other-day era before 1987-08)

resources.description: Daily mean atmospheric CO2 at Mauna Loa Observatory (NOAA GML); days without valid measurements are absent.

fields.name: decimal_date
fields.description: Date as a decimal year, as published by NOAA GML

fields.name: co2_ppm
fields.description: Daily mean CO2 mole fraction, parts per million (dry air)

resources.description: Monthly greenhouse gas averages from NOAA GML in long format (one row per series and month).

fields.name: series
fields.description: co2_mlo (Mauna Loa, ppm), co2_global (ppm), ch4_global (ppb), n2o_global (ppb) or sf6_global (ppt)

fields.name: date
fields.description: First day of the month, YYYY-MM-DD

fields.name: average
fields.description: Monthly mean in the series' unit; empty where NOAA reports missing

fields.name: deseasonalized
fields.description: Monthly value with the average seasonal cycle removed, as published by NOAA GML

fields.name: interpolated
fields.description: co2_mlo only, from 1974-05: True where NOAA filled a missing month by interpolation (negative stdev in the source file); empty for other series and for the Scripps months before 1974-05

resources.description: Daily area-weighted mean sea surface temperature computed from NOAA OISST v2.1 (0.25 degree, cos-latitude weights, ocean cells only).

fields.name: world_60s_60n
fields.description: Mean SST between 60S and 60N, degrees Celsius

fields.name: world_60s_60n_anom_1991_2020
fields.description: world_60s_60n minus its 1991-2020 mean for the same calendar day (Feb 29 uses Feb 28), degrees Celsius

fields.name: north_atlantic_0_60n_0_80w_anom_1991_2020
fields.description: North Atlantic mean minus its 1991-2020 mean for the same calendar day, degrees Celsius
